newsitem.title: USA: Musicland Stores sales drop in March. [CORRECTED 23:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Musicland Stores sales drop in March. [CORRECTED 23:00 GMT]

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Thursday a combination of factors led to a 4.9-percent decline in same-store sales and an 11.3-percent drop in total sales in March.

The company said the fact there was one less shopping day in March because of Easter contributed to the sales decrease. Additionally, there was a comparable lack of depth of new music and video releases that usually drive Easter gift sales, Musicland said.
Musicland, which operates a chain of music and video stores, also had fewer stores this year compared with March last year.
The company's shares were unchanged Thursday at 1-1/4.
